title: Lodash version leaking to the global scope
body:
It seems that we are currently exposing our internal lodash dependency to the outside world.

```
<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
</head>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/g/instantsearch.js@1.3.0"></script>;
  <script>
    console.log(_.VERSION);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/13565826/c74589a0-e452-11e5-87b6-1c6edb506b0b.png)

This is especially an issue when you also try to load a newer version of lodash in your page and it gets replaced with this one :)
